metadata.title: Efficient Decision-Making by Volume-Conserving Physical Object

extraction_notes.note: The letter has no section headings (only an unnumbered Acknowledgement), so every node has section null.
The label eq:cond1 is defined twice (on the second line of (5)-(6) and on (7)); it is never referenced, so no edge depends on it.
Apparent typos kept verbatim: E(S)=(mu_A+mu_B)N should be a difference, and N_N stands for N_B in N = N_A + N_N.
Table 1 (estimates of each reward probability when gamma is known) is a float and has no node; DP8 depends on it through 'From the above estimates'.
The Chernoff bound Q(x) <= exp(-x^2/2)/2 is stated inline in the same sentence that names the regret, so it gets no separate theorem node; it is part of DP12.
DP4 is one 'Here, ...' sentence introducing five symbols and cannot be split below a sentence; phi and phi_T are defined in 'where' sentences kept inside the result nodes ClP11 and ClP15.
TOW dynamics is the authors' earlier algorithm (cited kim1-kim6) restated here; marked external, though the letter's contribution is its analysis.

metadata.extraction_comment: Results are physics-style derivations (CLT/Gaussian approximations, heuristic separation conditions) rather than proved theorems; derived quantities are kept as equation and claim nodes.

nodes.statement: E(N_B) & = & Sigma_t=0^N-1 Q(phi sqrtt) nonumber \\ & leq & Sigma_t=0^N-1 frac12 exp(-fracphi^22 t) nonumber \\ & = & frac12 + Sigma_t=1^N-1 frac12 exp(-fracphi^22 t) nonumber \\ & leq & frac12 + int_0^N-1 frac12 exp(-fracphi^22 t) dt nonumber \\ & = & frac12 - frac1phi^2 left( exp(-fracphi^22(N-1)) - 1 right) \\ & rightarrow & frac12 + frac1phi^2 .
nodes.raw_latex:
\begin{eqnarray}
E(N_B) & = & \Sigma_{t=0}^{N-1} {\bf Q}(\phi \sqrt{t}) \nonumber \\
       & \leq & \Sigma_{t=0}^{N-1} \frac{1}{2} \exp(-\frac{\phi^2}{2} t) \nonumber \\
       & = & \frac{1}{2} + \Sigma_{t=1}^{N-1} \frac{1}{2} \exp(-\frac{\phi^2}{2} t) \nonumber \\
       & \leq & \frac{1}{2} + \int_{0}^{N-1} \frac{1}{2} \exp(-\frac{\phi^2}{2} t) dt \nonumber \\
       & = & \frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{\phi^2} \left( \exp(-\frac{\phi^2}{2}(N-1))  - 1  \right) \\
       & \rightarrow & \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{\phi^2} .
\end{eqnarray}
